# Muhammet TURŞAK — Senior Software Architect

> Senior Software Architect with 25+ years of professional experience leading enterprise software projects across Healthcare IT, Construction IT, E-Learning, and E-Commerce domains. Based in Ankara, Turkey. Currently Director of Technology at Jengai, New York, USA.

## About

Muhammet TURŞAK is a Senior Software Architect and technology leader with expertise in .NET, Java, and full-stack web/mobile development. Over his career he has held roles as Software Group Director, R&D Director, Project Manager, Software Architect, and Team Leader. He has delivered multi-million dollar enterprise systems for clients across Turkey, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Central Asia.

New York, USA. Leading development of the Jengai App, an AI-powered CRM and Estimation Suite for commercial contractors.

New York, USA. Built the Gamyte App, a construction IT platform for commercial contractors.

Ankara, Turkey. Led healthcare IT projects deployed across multiple countries including Kosovo, Palestine, and Saudi Arabia.

Ankara, Turkey. Delivered healthcare IT, e-commerce, and video streaming platforms.

**Fonet Software** — R&D Director (Jan 2010 – Aug 2011)
Ankara, Turkey. Directed research and development for hospital information systems.

**Halici Informatics** — Software Production & Planning Director (Jan 2004 – Sep 2008)
Ankara, Turkey. Progressed from developer to director; delivered LMS platforms and e-government projects.
